[[Armind's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Armind the Balancer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Bahdok Caverns]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:Death Magic +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:Halves casting time of Death Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
